description: This Java interface defines a functional interface for JMS message processing that can throw JMSExceptions, including a static method to wrap such functions and convert exceptions to runtime exceptions.

classes.name: JmsExceptionThrowingFunction
classes.description: A functional interface for processing JMS messages that may throw JMSException, with a static method for wrapping the functional interface to convert checked exceptions into runtime exceptions.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Processes a JMS message and returns a result, potentially throwing a JMSException.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Converts a JmsExceptionThrowingFunction into a standard Function, wrapping JMSExceptions into JMSRuntimeExceptions.
